slides.title: It's about to get dark at 5pm. The evening reset for tired brains.
Lights on, timer on
slides.body: When the sun goes down, turn on the lamps and set a 10-minute timer. Dark is the cue, not the clock.

slides.title: One sweep, one room
slides.body: Pick the room you wake up to. Cups to the sink, blankets to the basket. Done.

slides.title: Set out tomorrow
slides.body: Bag, keys and shoes by the door. Morning you won't have to search in the dark.

slides.title: Close the kitchen light
slides.body: When the kitchen light goes off, the kitchen is done. A clear end makes it easier to stop.

slides.title: Shorter days don't mean less me. They mean smaller resets.
Get the evening reset checklist
slides.body: The Tidy Brain Printable Pack has a printable evening checklist for dark, tired nights. Link in bio.
